summary: SaverOne 2014 Ltd. files a Form 6-K reporting completion of Stage 2 and Stage 3 closings under an Exchange Agreement with VisionWave Holdings, Inc. SaverOne issued 31,452,192,000 restricted ordinary shares (728,060 ADSs) to VisionWave and assignee Adrian Holdings S.R.L. in exchange for 945,251 restricted shares of VisionWave common stock valued at approximately $5,047,640 (based on $5.34 VWAP). Post-exchange, VisionWave beneficially owns ~41% of SaverOne's outstanding shares, accounted for under the equity method. The transaction provides SaverOne a non-exclusive license to VisionWave's RF intellectual property. Watch for integration milestones and potential regulatory or shareholder reaction.
